players.product: High-density AI data-center colocation / powered infrastructure (ex-Bitcoin-mining conversion)

quarterly_data.signal: ERCOT electrical power status for the Texas data centers: Denton's existing 297 MW is conditionally approved as 'Base Load, Pathway (a)' (load energized before March 25, 2022) and is not subject to the Batch Zero process, and an additional 74 MW to be energized was validated in ERCOT's 2025 Regional Transmission Plan study cases. Pecos' existing 300 MW is conditionally approved in Batch Zero as 'Base Load, Pathway (b)' and an additional 300 MW as 'Studied Load'; the final allocation and load ramp await the conclusion of Batch Zero. Hunt's planned 431 MW is conditionally approved in Batch Zero as 'Base Load, Advancing Large Load, Pathway (e)': interconnection studies are complete, ERCOT approved the 431 MW stability study, collateral is posted, long-lead equipment has been ordered and construction has commenced.
quarterly_data.figure: Denton 297 MW conditionally approved plus 74 MW in the 2025 RTP study cases; Pecos 300 MW base load plus 300 MW studied load conditionally approved; Hunt 431 MW conditionally approved
